blocks.text: The Brahmins were seized, pressed hard, and told to accept Islam if they wished to save their lives and honor. (11–12)
Hearing this, all were thrown into grief, as if whole households had died at once. (13)
The Brahmins cried out in distress, for no relief was visible to them by day or night.
